source: “You know the doctor’s ways, sir,” replied Poole, “and how he shuts himself up. Well, he’s shut up again in the cabinet; and I don’t like it, sir—I wish I may die if I like it. Mr. Utterson, sir, I’m afraid.”
originalTranslation: “jan Utason o, sina sona e nasin pi jan Jekil pi sona sijelo, e ni: ona li awen taso lon tomo insa. tenpo ni la, ona li awen sin lon tomo insa pi jan Jekil. mi pilin pona tan ni la, mi o moli—mi pilin pona ala a. jan Utason o, mi pilin monsuta,” jan Pulu li toki.
requiredPreservation: Preserve fear, cabinet confinement, and speech rhythm.
